text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The time has finally come for Mihono Bourbon and I to take on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning the Classic Triple Crown is both her and her father's wish. In order to achieve that, she'll have to overcome the challenge of long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her natural aptitude is for short-distance sprinting. A fellow trainer even warns me not to ruin her talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon calmly rejects the other master's warning, however, and continues to work toward making her and her father's dream a reality.
